title: Gray-Scott
text: The classic: spots that grow and divide until they fill the field.

title: One rule, new colours
text: The same Gray-Scott field under a fresh random palette from 🎲.

title: One rule, new colours
text: Another 🎲 roll: every reagent coloured and blended together.

title: Coral
text: Gray-Scott's coral preset: branching growth that crowds the field.

title: Maze, erased and regrown
text: A maze grows from a few seeds; soft erase strokes cut through it and it fills them back in.

title: Waves
text: Rings expand, collide and cancel.

title: U-skate
text: A few skaters glide among slowly settling stripes.

title: Explorer
text: Nine variants of a rule side by side. Tap one and it becomes the centre, with new variants around it.

title: Glider meets lamp
text: The same glider and lamp, in other colours.

title: Glider meets lamp
text: A glider runs into a lamp, a painted region where its trail never fades: the lamp lights up and stays lit after the glider has gone.

title: Soliton reflector
text: Gliders turned through 90° by a chain of still solitons: a reflector built only from the medium's own structures.

title: Memory latch
text: The same latch in other colours: set by one glider, reset by another.

title: Memory latch
text: The same latch, further along, in other colours.

title: Memory latch
text: A memory cell after Levin's bioelectric pattern memory: one glider switches it on, and it stays on until a second glider switches it off.

title: Fast gliders
text: A dozen elongated spots gliding across the field, from a search for fast gliders in a Gray-Scott variant.

title: Lineages
text: Four dishes grow their own patterns; then the walls come down and they meet.

title: Lava lamp
text: Phase-field bubbles rising warm and sinking cool, carried round each other by a slowly changing swirl.

title: Foam
text: Phase-field bubbles pressed into a foam.

title: Smoke ribbons
text: The same smoke rule, from the start, in other colours.

title: Smoke ribbons
text: A smoke rule from Ready holding at full strength in busy, curling ribbons and vortices.

title: Smoke threads
text: Smoke mixed with Gray-Scott: threads that wander through drifting clouds.
